source_caption:
“I’m so sick of people saying that love is just all a woman is fit for.” ❤️‍🩹

Saoirse Ronan received her fourth Oscar nomination for her performance in Little Women at the age of 25, making her the second-youngest performer—male or female—to receive four Oscar nominations. The current record holder, Jennifer Lawrence, reached that milestone a few months earlier than Ronan.

After learning that the adaptation was in the works, Ronan reached out to director Greta Gerwig and told her she had decided she would play Jo March. Gerwig was initially hesitant to cast Ronan after having just worked with her on Lady Bird (2017), but after realizing that essentially casting herself was a very Jo-like thing to do, Gerwig sent Ronan an email that read, “Yes, you’re Jo.”
